payload.name: JusticeNow Library
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
JusticeNow Library brings the Chilean legal corpus into ChatGPT: rulings from the Supreme Court, the Courts of Appeals and first-instance courts; statutes, decrees and codes from the Library of Congress; Constitutional Court decisions; administrative rulings from the Comptroller General, the Labor Directorate, the tax authority (SII), the financial regulator (CMF) and the Superintendencies; and academic legal scholarship.

Ask in plain language and ChatGPT searches the corpus, opens the official document and answers with the full citation —docket number, date, court or agency— and a link to the source, so every statement can be verified. Nothing is quoted without opening the document.

Requires a JusticeNow account with a plan that includes Library. Searches draw down that plan's credits; opening documents is free.
payload.longDescription:
JusticeNow Library将智利法律文献库引入ChatGPT：包含最高法院、上诉法院及初审法院的裁判文书；国会图书馆的法规、法令及法典；宪法法院的裁决；审计长办公室、劳动局、国家税务局（SII）、金融监管局（CMF）及各监管局的行政裁决；以及学术界的法律研究成果。

用通俗语言提问，ChatGPT将搜索法律文献库，打开官方文件并提供完整引用信息——包括案号、日期、法院或机构名称以及来源链接，确保每项陈述均可验证。所有引用均需先打开文件确认。

需要拥有包含文献库权限的JusticeNow账户，搜索操作将消耗该计划的信用点，而打开文档本身免费。

payload.name: Tito
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Tito is Twinbook's study assistant. Ask ChatGPT to push a paper, article, link, YouTube video or its own research notes into one of your Twinbook spaces, and Twinbook turns it into structured notes, quizzes and flashcards. Figures, sources and structure are kept, and long documents are split at section boundaries within your plan's limits.
payload.longDescription: Tito是Twinbook的学习助手。您可让ChatGPT将论文、文章、链接、YouTube视频或其自身研究笔记推送到Twinbook的任一空间中，Twinbook会将其转化为结构化笔记、测验和记忆卡片。图表、来源和结构都会被保留，而长文档会在您的计划限制范围内按章节边界进行拆分。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Save a paper or article into a study space, Import a public link or YouTube video, Save ChatGPT research notes as a document, Check remaining plan allowance before importing

payload.name: 3GPP Scout
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: 3GPP Scout helps telecom engineers, standards delegates and consultants search its own index of public 3GPP specifications, meeting contributions (TDocs), decisions and company positions. Find a clause or recorded outcome, then check a short excerpt with its document number, version and source link. Review and confirm targets to follow a topic in your Scout account, with optional email digests. Requires a Scout account and uses its request limits. Coverage varies by release and working group; a proposal is not an agreed outcome. Purchases are not available inside the plugin. 3GPP Scout is an independent product and is not affiliated with, endorsed or sponsored by 3GPP, ETSI or any 3GPP Organizational Partner. 3GPP™ is a trade mark of ETSI registered for the benefit of its Members and of the 3GPP Organizational Partners. Excerpts are quoted for reference and the official documents govern. Copyright, correction or removal requests: contact@3gppscout.com.

payload.name: Servanta
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Research monitored print, web, TV, radio, and transcript coverage in your organization's Servanta archive. Search exact terms or concepts, retrieve full articles, compare coverage, and prepare source-linked summaries. Results are limited to content available to the connected Servanta account.
payload.longDescription: 在您组织的Servanta档案库中研究监控的印刷媒体、网络、电视、广播和文字稿覆盖情况。搜索精确术语或概念，获取完整文章，比较覆盖情况，并生成带来源链接的摘要。结果仅限于已连接的Servanta账户可访问的内容。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Search monitored media, Retrieve full articles

payload.name: Classic Audioguide
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Discover published museum exhibitions, browse localized exhibit information, access audio-guide content, and identify an exhibit from a visitor-provided photo. Nearby search can use an approximate city-level location. Photo identification sends the visitor photo and selected catalog information to Google Gemini for matching.
payload.longDescription:
发现已发布的博物馆展览，浏览本地化展览信息，访问音频导览内容，并通过游客提供的照片识别展品。
附近搜索可使用大致的城市级别位置。
照片识别功能会将游客照片和选定的目录信息发送至Google Gemini进行匹配。

payload.name: Great Question
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Great Question puts your whole research workflow inside ChatGPT and Codex. Create research studies, recruit participants, and pull what customers said, without leaving the chat. All backed by verbatim quotes you can trace to the session.

You don't need to know which study holds the answer. Ask "What have customers said about our checkout in the last six months?" and it searches your transcripts, highlights and insights, then comes back with quotes, so everyone on your team makes research-backed decisions with confidence.

It works the other way too. Describe what you want to learn and it sets up the study, an interview, survey or prototype test, with the screener, incentive and participants ready for you to review.

Your existing Great Question permissions apply, so it only sees what you can see.
payload.longDescription:
Great Question将整个研究工作流程整合至ChatGPT和Codex中。创建研究项目、招募参与者并提取客户原话，全程无需离开聊天界面。所有内容均配有可追溯至原始会话的原话引用。

您无需知道哪项研究包含答案。询问「过去六个月客户对我们结账流程有何评价？」系统将搜索您的对话记录、重点内容和洞察，返回相关原话引用，确保团队成员都能自信地做出基于研究的决策。

反向操作同样适用。描述您想了解的内容，系统将自动设置研究方案——包括访谈、问卷调查或原型测试，并准备好筛选问卷、激励措施和参与者供您审核。

您现有的Great Question权限设置将被保留，因此系统仅能访问您有权查看的内容。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Search what customers said, Pull top complaints with quotes, Read transcripts and highlights, Create research studies and screeners, Shortlist and invite participants, Set interview availability

payload.name: DSTI School of Engineering
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Apply to DSTI School of Engineering with guided support in ChatGPT. Explore programmes and entry requirements, start or resume an application, review what remains, prepare updates, and submit only after your explicit confirmation. Approved study-abroad agencies can also support applicants they represent. Guidance comes directly from DSTI's application system. Documents, identity checks, payments and restricted personal information remain within the secure DSTI Application Portal.
payload.longDescription: 通过ChatGPT的指导支持申请DSTI工程学院。探索课程及入学要求，启动或继续申请，审查剩余事项，准备更新内容，并在您明确确认后提交。经批准的海外留学机构也可为其所代表的申请人提供支持。所有指导信息均直接来自DSTI申请系统。文件、身份验证、付款及受限个人信息均保留在安全的DSTI申请门户中。

payload.name: Perfume Picks
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Perfume Picks looks up about 13,000 fragrances with note pyramids, accords, concentration, community longevity, sillage and compliment scores, and list price. Ask what smells like a designer scent for less and get curated dupes with a match percentage and the price difference. Compare two fragrances side by side, get picks from the notes you like with a budget and an occasion, or ask what to wear tonight. Wear scores are community ratings, and list prices are the brand's MSRP. Perfume Picks is read-only: it doesn't sell anything or see anyone's personal wardrobe.
payload.longDescription: Perfume Picks 可查询约13,000种香水的香调金字塔、调性、浓度、用户评价的持久度、扩散性及好评度，并显示建议零售价。询问哪些香水气味类似设计师香水但价格更亲民，并获取精选的替代品，包含匹配百分比及价格差异。可对比两种香水，根据您喜欢的香调、预算及场合获取推荐，或询问今晚该穿哪款香水。用户评价为社区评分，建议零售价为品牌方的MSRP。Perfume Picks 为只读模式：不销售任何产品，也不查看用户的个人香水收藏。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Search fragrances, Find dupes, Compare fragrances, Recommendations

payload.name: Derive
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect your Derive notebook to ChatGPT to search and ask about your handwritten STEM notes. Find relevant excerpts, list recent pages, read recognized page text, and inspect available page previews. Text results respect your access to pages, including shared pages. Page previews require an accessible saved thumbnail. The tools do not edit or delete notebook content. Recognized text can contain errors, and long page results can be truncated.
payload.longDescription:
将您的Derive笔记本连接至ChatGPT，可搜索并查询手写的STEM笔记。
查找相关摘录、列出最近页面、阅读已识别的页面文本，并查看可用的页面预览。
文本结果会尊重您对页面的访问权限，包括共享页面。
页面预览需要可访问的已保存缩略图。
这些工具不会编辑或删除笔记本内容。
已识别文本可能包含错误，且长页面结果可能被截断。

payload.name: Dopamine Club
payload.description: 肽类与认知增强剂研究
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Explore research on peptides, nootropics, supplements and other compounds inside ChatGPT. Look up retatrutide, BPC-157, L-Theanine or Bacopa to read Dopamine Club's published research, follow original study links and see what the community reports.

Compare two to four profiles, filter cited studies by source classification, and view available website scores, research grades, report counts, sentiment and reported effects or side effects. Source dates, review verdicts, missing data and disclosed text omissions remain visible.

Designed for general-audience educational research. Results come from a versioned Dopamine Club snapshot, not a live or exhaustive literature search. Community reports are anecdotes; counts represent classified mentions rather than unique people. Website scores do not measure clinical effectiveness, personal safety or the percentage of people helped. Administration guidance, promotional passages and unqualified safety claims are withheld; historical study doses are not recommendations. No diagnosis, treatment advice, dosing guidance, vendor recommendations or purchases.
payload.longDescription:
在ChatGPT内部探索肽类、认知增强剂、补充剂及其他化合物的研究。
可查询Retatrutide、BPC-157、L-茶氨酸或 Bacopa，阅读Dopamine Club发布的研究成果，追踪原始研究链接并查看社区报告。

可对比两到四个资料档案，按来源分类筛选引用研究，并查看可用网站评分、研究评级、报告数量、情感倾向及报告中的效果或副作用。
来源日期、评审结论、缺失数据和披露文本遗漏部分仍会显示。

专为大众受众的教育性研究设计。
结果来自经过版本化的Dopamine Club快照，而非实时或全面的文献检索。
社区报告均为个人经历；数量仅表示分类提及次数而非独立个体。
网站评分不衡量临床有效性、个人安全性或受益人群比例。
不提供管理指南、宣传内容及未经验证的安全声明；历史研究剂量不构成建议。
不提供诊断、治疗建议、剂量指导、供应商推荐或购买行为。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Search compound research, Read cited studies, Explore scores and community, Compare compound profiles

payload.name: SongDecoder
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: SongDecoder helps readers examine song lyrics through textual evidence. It separates what the lyrics state from interpretation, maps the speaker's frame and central conflict, and considers possible psychological mechanisms, alternative readings, and effects on listeners. It does not diagnose people or infer an artist's beliefs from a narrator's words. Music, vocal performance, and historical context are assessed only when that material is provided or otherwise available.
payload.longDescription: SongDecoder帮助读者通过文本证据审视歌曲歌词。它将歌词中明确陈述的内容与解读区分开来，绘制出说话者的视角和核心冲突，并考虑可能的心理机制、替代性解读以及对听众的影响。它不会对个人进行诊断，也不会从叙述者的言辞中推断艺术家的信念。音乐、人声表现和历史背景的评估仅在提供相关材料或可获取的情况下进行。

payload.name: SEND Parents Help
payload.description: 为家长提供的友好SEND帮助
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
SEND Parents Help gives parents and carers in England clear, checked guidance on special educational needs and disabilities (SEND) and disability benefits for children and young people.

Ask about EHC needs assessments and EHCPs, SEN support at school, annual reviews, school places and school transport, and SEND Tribunal appeals. Or ask about Disability Living Allowance for children, PIP, Carer's Allowance, Attendance Allowance, Blue Badges, mandatory reconsiderations and benefit appeals.

What you can do:
- Get plain-English explanations of each step, including the deadlines that apply.
- Look up the exact wording of a question on supported benefit and SEND Tribunal forms, such as question 64 on the child DLA form, and get help putting your answer into words.
- Find your council's SEND contacts, local EHCP process and support services.
- Get help understanding a decision letter, report or form you have received.
- Ask questions about a SEND Parents Help article you are reading.

Answers come from the SEND Parents Help knowledge base, written from official guidance and legislation. Figures such as benefit rates and time limits come from a maintained register of facts, each with its source, rather than from memory.

SEND Parents Help is run by SEND Parents Help CIC, a Community Interest Company. The guidance covers England only and is general information, not legal advice. The tools only read our published guidance and need no account.
payload.longDescription:
SEND Parents Help为英格兰的家长和照护者提供关于特殊教育需求和残疾（SEND）以及儿童和青少年残疾福利的清晰核查指导。

可咨询教育健康护理评估和教育健康护理计划（EHCP），学校提供的特殊教育需求（SEN）支持，年度评审，学校名额和校车服务，以及SEND法庭上诉。
或咨询儿童残疾生活津贴、个人护理津贴（PIP）、照护者津贴、出席津贴、蓝色通行证、强制性重新考虑及福利上诉。

您可以：
- 获取每一步骤的通俗易懂解释，包括适用的截止日期。
- 查找支持福利和SEND法庭表格中具体问题的准确表述，例如儿童DLA表格中的第64题，并获得帮助将您的答案转化为文字。
- 查找您所在委员会的SEND联系人、当地EHCP流程和支持服务。
- 获得帮助理解您收到的决定信、报告或表格。
- 对您正在阅读的SEND Parents Help文章提出问题。

答案源自由官方指导和法规编写而成的SEND Parents Help知识库。
诸如福利金额和时限等数据来自维护中的事实登记册，每个数据均有来源标注，而非依赖记忆。

SEND Parents Help由SEND Parents Help CIC（社区利益公司）运营。
该指导仅适用于英格兰，为一般信息，不构成法律建议。
工具仅读取我们发布的指导内容，无需账户。

payload.name: Learn It
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Send a photo of a textbook page or a handwritten word list, attach a document, paste your notes, or just say what you want to practice. You get one short link that opens the quiz in Learn It, where you see every question before you add it.

Learn It is an app for practicing vocabulary and quiz questions on iPhone and iPad, used by more than 300,000 students, most of them in Sweden. Practicing there is different from being asked questions in a chat. For a decade, since 2016, the app has been refined around what you see, hear and feel at every answer: animation, sound and haptic feedback tuned to keep practice short, focused and rewarding. That is particularly helpful for students with learning challenges, who often find it hard to get started and to keep going. You practice with multiple choice, by writing the answers, or with flashcards.

Learn It also keeps track of what you have learned. It keeps a record of every word you practice and uses spaced repetition to show which words are due for review, at growing intervals, so you go back to them before you forget them.

There is no account and nothing to sign in to. On a device without the app, the link shows the quiz on trylearnit.com. Ask for changes at any time and you get a new link.

To make the link, the quiz (its name, questions and answers) is sent to Learn It and stored there under a quiz code, the same way a quiz shared from the app is. Anyone who has the link or the code can open the quiz, so leave personal information out of it. Nothing else from your conversation is sent to Learn It.

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Make a quiz to practice in Learn It

payload.name: Accent Oracle by BoldVoice
payload.summaryOriginal: Find out what accent you have
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Find out what your English accent sounds like with Accent Oracle by BoldVoice, the accent and pronunciation coaching app, right inside ChatGPT. Read a short paragraph aloud and BoldVoice predicts the accents your recording sounds most like, with probabilities and regions. If the first guess is uncertain, BoldVoice asks for one more paragraph to sharpen it. Ask ChatGPT to explain your result. Predictions describe how the recording sounds, not where you are from. No download, account or login needed. Your recording is sent to BoldVoice for analysis only when you stop recording.
payload.longDescription: 在ChatGPT中直接使用BoldVoice推出的Accent Oracle，即可了解你的英语口音特征。朗读一段短文后，BoldVoice会分析你的录音并预测最相似的口音类型及对应概率与地区。若首次预测结果不确定，BoldVoice会要求再提供一段文字以提高准确性。可让ChatGPT解释你的分析结果。预测结果仅描述语音特征，不涉及地理来源信息。无需下载、注册或登录账户，您的录音仅在停止录制时才会发送至BoldVoice进行分析。

payload.name: Whiteboard Video Maker
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Turn any topic into a narrated whiteboard animation video without leaving ChatGPT. Describe what you want explained, and Whiteboard Video Maker writes the script, draws each scene with a hand-drawn whiteboard animation and adds a natural voiceover. Choose the length, landscape (YouTube) or portrait (Shorts, Reels, TikTok), the narration language and the voice. Videos render in a few minutes; ask whether your video is ready to get the MP4 download link and thumbnail. You can also list your recent videos and check your credit balance. Requires a Whiteboard Video account; videos use the account's credits (1 credit per minute) and ChatGPT asks you to confirm before creating one.
payload.longDescription: 无需离开ChatGPT即可将任何主题转化为带旁白的白板动画视频。描述需要解释的内容，Whiteboard Video Maker会撰写脚本，用手绘白板动画绘制每个场景并添加自然语音旁白。可选择视频时长、画布方向（YouTube横版或Shorts/Reels/TikTok竖版）、旁白语言和配音声音。视频几分钟内即可生成；可询问视频是否准备好以获取MP4下载链接和缩略图。您还可以查看最近制作的视频并检查积分余额。需要Whiteboard Video账户；视频会消耗账户积分（每分钟1积分），ChatGPT会在创建前向您确认。

payload.name: Talkio Practice
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Prepare for travel, a job interview, a work meeting, or everyday conversation with short Talkio role-plays. Your assistant conducts the exercise, offers hints, and gives feedback on your replies. No Talkio account is required. Voice depends on the host. This plugin does not provide acoustic pronunciation scores or save progress to Talkio. An optional informational link explains Talkio and this practice activity. No purchases or subscription upgrades are offered.
payload.longDescription: 通过简短的Talkio角色扮演，为旅行、工作面试、工作会议或日常对话做好准备。您的助手将引导练习，提供提示并针对您的回复给予反馈。无需Talkio账户。语音由主机决定。此插件不提供发音评分或保存练习进度至Talkio。可选的信息链接解释了Talkio及此练习活动。不提供购买或订阅升级选项。

payload.name: MasterPiano
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
MasterPiano helps piano learners find music they can actually play. Ask for classical sheet music by title, composer, era, ABRSM grade or level, and the score appears right in the chat with a play button, its MasterPiano level (1 to 100) and its approximate ABRSM grade.

What you can ask:
- Find sheet music: "a grade 3 Baroque piece", "easy Chopin", "Gymnopédie No. 1".
- Show and play a piece: the opening bars as notation with a real piano sound.
- Suggest fingering: finger numbers for both hands on the opening bars.
- Check a piece's difficulty: level, approximate grade, what makes it hard and easier pieces to learn first.
- Create a sight-reading exercise: a fresh exercise at your level, in the key and time signature you choose.

The library covers public-domain classical piano music (composers who died by 1925, from Bach to Debussy and Joplin). Songs still under copyright are not available. The card shows the opening bars; each card links to the piece's page on masterpiano.com, where you can read the whole score and practise it with live feedback on your piano. No account or sign-in needed. The plugin cannot hear you play.
payload.longDescription:
MasterPiano帮助钢琴学习者找到他们能实际演奏的乐谱。您可以通过标题、作曲家、时期、ABRSM等级或级别查找古典乐谱，乐谱会直接在聊天中显示，并带有播放按钮，同时标注其MasterPiano等级（1至100）和大致的ABRSM等级。

您可以进行以下操作：
- 查找乐谱："3级巴洛克作品"、"简单肖邦"、"Gymnopédie No. 1"。
- 展示并播放乐曲：以实际钢琴音色呈现开头小节的乐谱。
- 推荐指法：标注开头小节左右手的指法编号。
- 检查乐曲难度：显示等级、大致等级、难度说明以及更适合初学的曲目。
- 创建视奏练习：根据您选择的调式和拍号生成适合当前等级的全新练习曲。

该库涵盖公共领域的古典钢琴音乐（作曲家于1925年前去世，涵盖从巴赫到德彪西及乔普林的作品）。
受版权保护的歌曲无法提供。
卡片显示开头小节；每张卡片链接至masterpiano.com上的乐曲页面，您可查看完整乐谱并使用实时反馈功能练习钢琴。
无需账户或登录。
该插件无法监听您的演奏。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Find piano sheet music, Show and play a piece, Suggest fingering, Check a piece's difficulty, Create a sight-reading exercise

payload.name: Paperpal
payload.description: 面向发表的科研辅助工具
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Paperpal for ChatGPT runs checks that catch issues before you submit: Grammar, Plagiarism, Reference Checks, and Journal Fit. Scan your document for grammar issues and get a deep polish, with results linking back to Paperpal for full review and a tracked-changes download. Run a plagiarism check to see where your document stands, backed by a full report. Check your references and citations across 9 categories, including retractions, hallucinations, excessive self-citation, and citation-reference mismatches. Check journal fit to see if your manuscript meets common pre-submission requirements before you send it in. Results link back to Paperpal for deeper review, full reports, and further manuscript enhancements.

Get started with prompts like:
'Paperpal, please check my references and citations.'
'Paperpal, does my manuscript have language errors?'
payload.longDescription:

payload.name: Chessigma

Also: the daily puzzle with its solution, and Elo estimates with FIDE, Chess.com or Lichess K-factor defaults (Chess.com and Lichess use Glicko ratings, so their real changes differ). No account needed.

For chess players of any level who want facts about openings, positions and games. Chessigma does not evaluate positions inside ChatGPT, does not play games, and cannot read your Chess.com or Lichess account: share a game link or a PGN instead.
payload.longDescription:
Chessigma通过开局指南、开局目录以及根据国际象棋规则计算的对局事实来解答国际象棋相关问题。询问伦敦开局、卡罗-卡恩防御、西西里防御等15种开局，可获取Chessigma开局指南中的主流变化、关键变例及双方策略；或直接输入3700种已收录开局线路名称，获取对应的埃科代码和走法。粘贴走法可识别开局并查看对局脱离理论的节点。粘贴FEN格式可获取当前行棋方、将死状态、棋子材料及所有合法着法。粘贴PGN格式可获取对局摘要（对局双方、结果、开局方式、对局结束方式）以及在chessigma.com分析板上打开该对局的链接，若PGN来自Chess.com实时对局或Lichess对局，还会提供复盘链接。分享Chess.com实时对局链接或Lichess对局链接，可获得该对局在chessigma.com的完整逐步复盘链接。这些页面中Stockfish引擎会在您的浏览器中运行。此外还包含每日谜题及答案，以及基于FIDE、Chess.com或Lichess K因子默认值的Elo评级（Chess.com和Lichess使用Glicko评级系统，因此实际变化可能有所不同）。无需账户即可使用。

payload.name: Fiveable for AP Teachers

Fiveable for AP Teachers connects your Fiveable teacher workspace to ChatGPT for AP grading, class materials, assignments, and insights.

Ask ChatGPT to use those results to draft a reteaching plan, parent note, or conference outline. When a class has no scored work, Fiveable reports that limitation.

With Google connected on Fiveable, list Classroom turn-ins, export grading results to a Google Sheet, and preview sending approved numeric AP scores to Classroom. Classroom documents can be imported on the Fiveable website. Sending scores does not send written feedback or return the work; you return it in Classroom yourself.

payload.name: Opterio
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Opterio works the optics math on the ABO and NCLE optician exams, one step at a time. Ask about a prescription or a frame and Opterio runs the calculation, shows every step, points out the trap the exam likes to set, and rounds to the nearest quarter diopter where that matters.

Twelve calculators:

- Transposition: move a prescription between plus- and minus-cylinder form.
- Spherical equivalent: sphere plus half the cylinder, naming both quarter steps when the result lands halfway.
- Vertex distance: compensate a prescription for a change in vertex distance, one meridian at a time, for example from glasses to contact lenses.
- Prentice's rule: induced prism and its base direction when the eye looks away from the optical center, for spheres and sphero-cylinders.
- Lens thickness: edge or center thickness from power, index and diameter, compared across common lens materials.
- Minimum blank size: the smallest lens blank a frame needs, from its effective diameter, eye size, bridge and the patient's PD.
- Base curve: Vogel's estimate of the front curve for a prescription, halving the spherical equivalent first for a minus lens.
- Lens power: the power from the front and back curves, with back vertex power for a thick lens and lens clock readings converted for the material.
- Prism resolver: horizontal and vertical prism combined into one resultant prism in 360-degree notation, or one prism split back into its parts.
- RGP fitting: a GP contact lens power from the K readings, the glasses prescription and the base curve, with the tear lens and any residual astigmatism.
- Near PD: the reading PD from the distance PD and the reading distance, with the three-quarter rule.
- Effective diameter: twice the longest radius from the boxing center, or an estimate from the frame box and how rounded the corners are.

Every answer comes with a card that shows the result and the working. Open it full screen to change any number and watch the answer update, see the diagram, and try an exam-style practice problem. Answers come in English, Spanish, French, Chinese, Tagalog, Vietnamese or Korean, following the language you write in.

Opterio is for study and for checking your own working. It isn't a prescribing tool and doesn't replace a clinician's judgment.

There's no account to create, and the calculators don't save what you enter.
payload.longDescription:
Opterio会逐步解析ABO和NCLE验光师考试中的光学数学问题。
输入处方或镜架参数后，Opterio会进行计算，展示所有步骤，指出考试常设的陷阱，并在需要时将结果四舍五入到四分之一屈光度。

12个计算器：

- 镜片换算：在正柱镜和负柱镜形式之间转换处方。
- 球镜等效：球镜加上柱镜的一半，当结果处于中间值时同时显示两个四分之一步数值。
- 顶点距离：根据顶点距离变化调整处方，逐个子午线计算，例如从眼镜到隐形眼镜的转换。
- 普林基定律：当眼睛偏离光学中心时，计算产生的三棱镜效应及其基底方向，适用于球镜和球柱镜。
- 镜片厚度：根据镜片度数、折射率和直径计算边缘或中心厚度，并对比常见镜片材料的数值。
- 最小镜片尺寸：根据镜框有效直径、瞳距、镜框宽度和镜片尺寸计算所需最小镜片 blank（毛坯）。
- 基曲计算：通过沃格尔公式估算处方的前曲率，对负镜片需先将球镜等效值减半。
- 镜片度数：通过前后面曲率计算镜片度数，包含厚镜片的后顶点度数，以及根据材料转换镜片测量仪读数。
- 三棱镜分解：将水平和垂直三棱镜合并为360度表示的合成三棱镜，或把单个三棱镜分解为组成部分。
- RGP配适计算：根据角膜曲率读数、眼镜处方和基曲计算硬性透气性隐形眼镜度数，包含泪液镜和残余散光因素。
- 近用瞳距：根据远用瞳距和阅读距离计算近用瞳距，遵循四分之三法则。
- 有效直径：从镜框中心最长半径的两倍计算，或根据镜框尺寸和镜角圆润度估算。

每个计算结果都会显示结果和计算过程卡片。
全屏打开可修改任意数值，实时查看答案变化，查看示意图并尝试考试风格练习题。
答案支持英语、西班牙语、法语、中文、他加禄语、越南语或韩语，根据您输入的语言自动切换。

Opterio用于学习和核对个人计算过程。

Journal AI policies: ask what a journal allows on AI authorship, disclosure statements, AI-generated images, and reviewers' or editors' use of AI. Answers come from Manusights' dated record of the official policy page, with that page linked; when a record is out of date or the page could not be fully read, it says so and links the page instead. Manuscript preview: attach a manuscript (PDF, Word, ODT, RTF, TXT, Markdown or LaTeX, up to 50 MB) for a readiness score, a verdict and the main risks a reviewer is likely to raise. You can also read reviews already on your Manusights account.

For researchers, students and reviewers who cite papers. Reference checks and journal AI-policy lookups work without an account. Manuscript previews and your saved reviews need a Manusights account; you can sign in with Google, an emailed link or a password.

Limitations: checks report what the sources hold. They cannot tell whether a reference supports a claim, and "could not be checked" (common for books, theses and conference papers without a DOI) is not a sign of a problem. "Not found" means the sources hold no record, which can also be a typo. Up to 100 references per check. Journal policies cover the journals in Manusights' records. payload.name: GridSmith Puzzle Maker
payload.description: 填字游戏、单词搜索、数独
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Make a crossword puzzle, a word search, or a sudoku right in the chat, play it there, and print it with an answer key.

Crossword maker: give it your vocabulary words and clues (or just the words, and a short clue is written for each) and GridSmith builds a real interlocking crossword grid with standard numbering and Across and Down clue lists. It searches many layouts to place as many answers as possible in a compact grid, strips accents and spaces from answers (ice cream becomes ICECREAM, shown as 3,5), and tells you plainly if an answer could not be connected. A crossword maker for teachers making weekly vocabulary worksheets, parents, and puzzle fans.

Word search maker: easy puzzles run words right and down for young kids, medium adds diagonals, and hard hides words in all eight directions including backwards. Every word is checked to appear exactly once, so there are no confusing duplicates in the filler letters, and any word that cannot be hidden is named with the reason.

Sudoku generator with answers: easy, medium or hard 9x9 sudoku, each verified by a solver to have exactly one solution. Easy and medium puzzles can be solved with simple elimination; every hard puzzle (24 to 30 givens) needs a technique beyond singles.

Play in the chat: type into the crossword with Check, Reveal word and Reveal all; drag across words in the word search; enter digits and pencil notes in sudoku. Print: every puzzle downloads as a printable PDF worksheet with name and date lines and a separate answer key page, in Letter or A4. The PDF always matches the puzzle on screen, and the same seed reproduces the same puzzle, so you can reprint an identical copy.

Limitations: crossword grids are open layouts with blank space around the words (not symmetric newspaper grids), crossword and word search grids use the letters A-Z only (accents are dropped, so words written only in Cyrillic or Greek cannot be placed), PDF titles and clues print in Latin alphabets including Polish, Czech and German, plus Greek and Cyrillic, but not Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Arabic or Hebrew, and sudoku is the classic 9x9 format.
payload.longDescription:
在聊天窗口直接制作填字游戏、单词搜索或数独，直接在聊天中游玩，并生成带答案页的可打印文档。

填字游戏制作器：输入你的词汇单词和提示（或仅输入单词，系统会为每个单词生成简短提示），GridSmith会生成标准编号的可互锁填字网格，包含横向和纵向提示列表。它会尝试多种布局，尽可能在紧凑网格中放置更多答案，会去除答案中的重音符号和空格（例如ice cream会变成ICECREAM，显示为3,5），并明确告知无法连接的答案。专为教师制作周词汇练习册、家长和谜题爱好者设计。

单词搜索制作器：简单难度的谜题仅横向和纵向排列单词适合幼儿，中等难度增加对角线方向，困难难度则在所有八个方向（包括反向）隐藏单词。每个单词都会被检查确保仅出现一次，避免填充字母中出现混淆重复，无法隐藏的单词会显示具体原因。

带答案的数独生成器：提供简单、中等或困难难度的9x9数独，每个谜题都经过求解器验证，确保仅有唯一解。简单和中等难度可通过基础排除法解决；每个困难难度谜题（给出24至30个数字）需要运用超越基础排除法的技巧。

在聊天中游玩：在填字游戏中使用检查、揭示单词和全部揭示功能；在单词搜索中拖动选择单词；在数独中输入数字和铅笔笔记。打印功能：所有谜题可下载为带姓名和日期行的可打印PDF练习册，以及单独的答案页，支持Letter或A4纸张。PDF内容始终与屏幕上的谜题一致，相同种子可重复生成相同谜题，方便重新打印完全相同的版本。

限制条件：填字游戏网格采用开放式布局（单词周围有空白空间，非对称报纸网格），填字和单词搜索网格仅使用A-Z字母（会去除重音符号，因此仅含西里尔字母或希腊字母的单词无法放置），PDF标题和提示使用拉丁字母印刷，包含波兰语、捷克语和德语，以及希腊语和西里尔字母，但不支持中文、日文、韩文、阿拉伯语或希伯来语，数独仅限经典9x9格式。

payload.name: QuizOffice
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
QuizOffice is an online platform where teachers create worksheets, quizzes and tests, assign them to their classes and follow the results.

With this plugin your AI assistant becomes your worksheet editor. Tell it what you need - subject, grade, number and type of questions - and it creates a draft worksheet in your own QuizOffice account. It can also edit your existing drafts, add or change questions, attach learning materials (for example a PDF the questions are based on) and use images from them.

Supported question types: single choice, multiple choice, true/false, short text answer, essay (graded by the teacher), sorting, pairing, select from list, fill in the blanks, find the word, and flashcards. Mathematical formulas are supported with LaTeX.

Safety by design: the assistant only ever creates drafts. Nothing is shown to students until you review and publish the worksheet in QuizOffice. You sign in with your QuizOffice account, and the assistant can only see and change your own worksheets, materials and images.
payload.longDescription:
QuizOffice是一个在线平台，教师可以在此创建练习册、测验和试卷，分配给班级并跟踪结果。

通过此插件，你的AI助手将成为你的练习册编辑器。告诉它你的需求——学科、年级、题目数量和类型——它会在你的QuizOffice账户中生成一份练习册初稿。它还可以编辑你现有的草稿，增减题目、附加学习材料（例如题目所基于的PDF文件）并引用其中的图片。

支持的题型：单选题、多选题、判断题、简答、论述题（由教师评分）、排序题、配对题、列表选择题、填空题、找单词和闪卡。数学公式支持LaTeX格式。

设计安全：助手仅创建草稿。在你于QuizOffice审核并发布练习册前，学生不会看到任何内容。你通过QuizOffice账号登录，助手只能查看和修改你的个人练习册、材料和图片。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Create draft worksheets from a topic, grade and question types, Add, edit and remove questions in your draft worksheets, Use 11 question types, images and LaTeX formulas, Attach learning materials and reuse images from them, List your worksheets, materials and media library

payload.name: AnyLawyer
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Research legislation, case law, regulator decisions, procurement materials, and legal registers from authoritative Polish, Central European, and EU sources. AnyLawyer returns source identifiers, citations, official links, and bounded excerpts when available.

Sources include Polish, Czech, Hungarian, and Slovak legislation; indexed EU regulations and directives with CELEX and EUR-Lex citations; Polish Supreme Court, common-court, administrative-court, Constitutional Tribunal, and procurement-appeal rulings; UOKiK, UODO, and KNF materials; Polish tax and labour-inspector interpretations; procurement notices; and current or full KRS company-register extracts.

All tools are read-only. AnyLawyer does not create, change, file, or delete records in any register. Results are research material, not legal advice. Sign-in with an AnyLawyer account is required.
payload.longDescription:
从权威的波兰、中欧和欧盟来源中检索立法、判例法、监管机构决定、采购资料和法律登记册。AnyLawyer会在可用时返回来源标识符、引用信息、官方链接以及限定摘录。

来源包括波兰、捷克、匈牙利和斯洛伐克的立法；带有CELEX和EUR-Lex引用的索引欧盟法规和指令；波兰最高法院、普通法院、行政法院、宪法法庭以及采购申诉裁决；UOKiK、UODO和KNF资料；波兰税务和劳工检查机构的解释文件；采购公告；以及当前或完整的企业登记册（KRS）摘录。

所有工具均为只读模式。AnyLawyer不会在任何登记册中创建、修改、提交或删除记录。结果仅为研究资料，不构成法律建议。需要使用AnyLawyer账户登录。

payload.name: AristAI Thinker
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
AristAI Thinker connects your teaching library to your AI. See how many papers, transcripts and other sources you have; find material on a topic; read cited excerpts; and compare your course goals with the material already in your library. Saved video links are listed separately from imported transcripts.

Sign in with your Thinker account and select a library you own. Every connection is limited to that library. Read-only access is the default. If you allow it, you can ask the AI to save a conversation summary and prepare profile suggestions for your review. Disconnect at any time in Thinker.

Search uses literal matching, so a zero result is a reason to investigate further, not proof that a topic is absent. AI recommendations depend on your teaching goals and the available sources.
payload.longDescription:
AristAI Thinker将您的教学资料库与AI连接。
查看您拥有多少论文、转录稿和其他资料；查找特定主题的材料；阅读引用摘录；并对比您的课程目标与资料库中现有内容。
已保存的视频链接会单独列出，而非与导入的转录稿混在一起。

使用您的Thinker账户登录，并选择您拥有的一个资料库。
每次连接仅限于该资料库。
默认为只读访问权限。
如果允许，您可以要求AI保存对话摘要，并为您的审核准备资料库建议。

搜索采用精确匹配方式，因此零结果意味着需要进一步调查，而非证明该主题不存在。
AI推荐内容取决于您的教学目标和可用资料。

payload.name: DAFi
payload.description: 使用您的DAFi笔记进行学习

The integration retrieves data available to your DAFi account. Explanations, practice questions, and study plans generated by ChatGPT remain in the conversation and are not automatically saved to DAFi. A DAFi account is required, and available content depends on your account permissions.

将您的DAFi账户连接至ChatGPT，即可使用专属课程。通过聊天提问查找课程，探索课程内容与核心概念，然后根据已有资料请求解析或练习题。

payload.name: CL for Desmos & Amplify
payload.description: 自定义活动构建器帮助
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Build custom activities in Amplify Classroom and Desmos Classroom with help from ChatGPT. Describe the activity you want in ordinary words: what you're teaching and how students should work through it. CL for Desmos & Amplify plans the screens and components, writes the Computation Layer (CL) code for each one, and tells you how to test every step in the activity builder.

It draws on a curated, read-only knowledge base of CL patterns, conventions and known pitfalls, and reproduces CL from it exactly. Anything it composes beyond a verified pattern is labeled unverified, with what to check. It works for experienced CL authors (terse and peer-level) and for teachers new to CL (one step at a time).

It can help with multiple choice, numeric and math input with equivalence checking, tables, graphs, choice grids, feedback and hints, randomized practice, rounds and levels, timed phases, and progress tracking across screens.

Limits: it can't see or change your Desmos or Amplify account; you paste the code into the activity builder yourself. Preview and test every activity before students use it.

An independent project by Aaron Veek. Not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by Desmos, Amplify or OpenAI.
payload.longDescription:
通过ChatGPT的帮助，在Amplify Classroom和Desmos Classroom中创建自定义活动。用日常语言描述你想构建的活动：正在教授的内容以及学生应如何参与。CL for Desmos & Amplify会规划屏幕和组件，为每个部分编写计算层（CL）代码，并指导你如何在活动构建器中测试每个步骤。

它基于经过筛选的只读CL模式知识库，包含CL模式、规范和已知陷阱，并能精确复现CL代码。任何超出验证模式的生成内容会被标记为未经验证，并附带检查说明。该工具既适用于有经验的CL作者（简洁且符合同行水平），也适用于初次接触CL的教师（分步指导）。

可支持单选题、数值和数学输入（含等价性检查）、表格、图表、选项网格、反馈提示、随机练习、关卡和阶段、定时环节，以及跨屏幕进度追踪功能。

限制条件：无法查看或修改你的Desmos或Amplify账户；需自行将代码粘贴到活动构建器中。在学生使用前请预览并测试所有活动。

独立项目由Aaron Veek开发。与Desmos、Amplify或OpenAI无关联，未获其认可或赞助。

information.label: Capabilities

Validate, estimate, submit, and monitor jobs across 300+ tools — structure prediction, docking, protein and antibody design, molecular dynamics, and property prediction. Chain tools into pipelines, batch many inputs at once, and pull back structures, results, and logs — all from chat.
payload.longDescription: 将 ChatGPT 连接到 Tamarind Bio 工作区，开展蛋白质和分子科学研究。使用 300+ 种工具验证、估算、提交并监控任务，涵盖结构预测、对接、蛋白质和抗体设计、分子动力学及性质预测。将工具串联成流水线，一次批量提交多个输入，并直接在聊天中获取结构、结果和日志。

payload.name: Inductive
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Inductive's absorption, distribution, metabolism, excretion, and toxicity (ADMET) models predict the chemical and pharmacokinetic properties that determine whether a molecule can become a viable drug. By surfacing these predictions directly in your conversation, scientists can evaluate compounds, triage ideas, and prioritize which molecules to synthesize, without leaving their existing workflow.

Through this MCP server, users can access Inductive’s models for the physicochemical properties LogD (lipophilicity) and pKa (acid/base ionization), key drivers of solubility and permeability.
payload.longDescription:
Inductive 的吸收、分布、代谢、排泄和毒性（ADMET）模型可预测决定分子能否成为可行药物的化学和药代动力学性质。科学家无需离开现有工作流，即可在对话中查看这些预测、评估化合物、筛选想法，并确定优先合成哪些分子。

通过此 MCP 服务器，用户可使用 Inductive 模型预测 LogD（亲脂性）和 pKa（酸碱电离）等物理化学性质；这些性质是溶解性和渗透性的关键影响因素。

payload.name: Genomic Intelligence

Give it a gene symbol, a genomic region, or a FASTA; it resolves the sequence from Ensembl and returns structured predictions. No local GPU, model weights, or API key required. For research use, not clinical or diagnostic decisions.
payload.longDescription: 通过托管的 Genomic Intelligence API 执行六类 DNA 序列分析任务：启动子区域预测、剪接供体/受体位点、增强子活性、染色质状态、序列到表达的预测，以及从头基因注释；还可执行“查找基因后预测表达”的组合工作流。输入基因符号、基因组区域或 FASTA 序列，应用会从 Ensembl 解析序列并返回结构化预测。无需本地 GPU、模型权重或 API 密钥。仅供研究使用，不用于临床或诊断决策。

payload.name: Pendar
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Pendar gives you the shape of a research field, not a summary of it.

Point it at a topic and it reports how many papers exist, whether output is growing or flattening, which disciplines and countries produce them, and which papers to read first. Every figure is counted across the whole corpus rather than estimated from a sample, so you can plan around it.

Point it at a paper and it traces what happened next: whether citations are rising or fading, which fields picked the work up, whether industry or academia is building on it, and which authors cite it most. That is how you tell a paper quietly becoming foundational from one that peaked years ago.

Paste a bibliography and it checks each reference against the published record: whether the paper exists, whether the citation describes it accurately, and whether it has been retracted. A reference it cannot find is reported as unverified rather than swapped for the nearest real paper, which matters when the citations came from a model.

Every tool is read-only. Pendar looks things up and reports what it finds.
payload.longDescription:
Pendar 为您展示研究领域的全貌，而不只是摘要。

输入一个主题，它会报告相关论文数量、研究产出是在增长还是趋于平缓、哪些学科和国家在产出论文，以及应优先阅读哪些论文。每项数据都基于整个语料库统计，而非根据样本估算，帮助您据此进行规划。

输入一篇论文，它会追踪后续发展：引用是在增加还是减少、哪些领域采用了这项研究、业界或学界是否在此基础上继续研究，以及引用该论文最多的作者。这有助于判断一篇论文是在悄然成为奠基性研究，还是早在数年前就已达到热度高峰。

粘贴参考文献目录后，它会逐条对照已发表记录进行核查：论文是否存在、引文描述是否准确，以及论文是否已撤稿。找不到的参考文献会标记为“未验证”，而不会替换成最接近的真实论文；当引文来自模型时，这一点尤为重要。

所有工具均为只读。Pendar 只会查找并报告结果。

payload.name: PeptidePrices COA Verifier
payload.description: 核验肽类 COA 证据
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Search and inspect public peptide certificates of analysis using the PeptidePrices evidence library and supported laboratory records. Look up exact report identifiers or public certificate URLs, review vendor and compound matches, inspect reported testing panels, browse a vendor’s published certificate feed, or compare documented COA coverage across vendors. Results keep laboratory-record confirmation, vendor attribution, product and labeled-strength matching, reported analytical results, and physical-vial chain of custody separate. Missing, blocked, unsupported, or unresolved records remain unknown rather than being treated as failures. Each result includes structured evidence and links to PeptidePrices, certificate documents, and specific official laboratory records when available.
payload.longDescription: 利用 PeptidePrices 证据库及受支持的实验室记录，搜索和检查公开的肽类分析证书（COA）。查找精确的报告编号或公开证书 URL，查看供应商和化合物的匹配情况，检查报告中的检测项目，浏览供应商发布的证书列表，或比较不同供应商有记录支持的 COA 覆盖情况。结果会分别呈现实验室记录确认、供应商归属、产品及标签标示含量或浓度的匹配、报告中的分析结果，以及实体样品瓶的保管交接链。缺失、访问受阻、不受支持或尚未解决的记录仍标为未知，不会被视为核验失败。每项结果都包含结构化证据，以及指向 PeptidePrices、证书文件和具体官方实验室记录（如有）的链接。

payload.name: Peptide Critic
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Peptide Critic provides independent vendor reviews, third-party lab testing and price comparison for research peptides such as BPC-157, GHK-Cu and TB-500. Find compounds by name or synonym, compare vendor ratings and review counts, inspect vendor-level lab-verified COA and warning flags, compare list and discounted prices per milligram, and find coupon codes. Filter comparisons by vendors' shipping origin and pack size, or look up a vendor profile. Results use Peptide Critic's Best Value ranking, which favors partners when offers are comparable; returned buy links are tracked affiliate links. The app returns public catalogue data without sign-in and does not place orders or process payments. Prescription-drug analogues are excluded from compound search and comparison. Research use only; no dosing or medical advice.
payload.longDescription: Peptide Critic 为 BPC-157、GHK-Cu 和 TB-500 等研究肽提供独立供应商评价、第三方实验室检测和价格比较。按名称或同义词查找化合物，比较供应商评分和评价数量，查看供应商级别的实验室验证 COA 及警示标志，比较每毫克的标价和折扣价，并查找优惠码。可按供应商发货地和包装规格筛选，或查看供应商档案。结果采用 Peptide Critic 的最佳价值排名，在报价相当时倾向合作伙伴；返回的购买链接为跟踪型联盟链接。应用无需登录即可返回公开目录数据，不下单也不处理付款。处方药类似物不纳入化合物搜索和比较。仅供研究使用；不提供剂量或医疗建议。

payload.name: HoldsUp
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: HoldsUp checks what health and science podcasts claim against the published research. Ask whether a claim has been checked and get the verdict (supported, overstated, needs context, contradicted or unverified), the GRADE certainty, a one-line note and the studies behind it with their PubMed id, evidence level and retraction status. Verify a new claim live against PubMed and OpenAlex in 20 to 70 seconds. Read a speaker's track record, a show, a topic, a single study, or the money behind it from public funding registers. Sign in by email, pay per call from prepaid credits (1 credit = 1 US cent: a read 1, a claim search 2, a live verification 30), and see the cost and your balance in every answer. Evidence summaries about published research, not medical advice.
payload.longDescription: HoldsUp 将健康和科学播客的说法与已发表研究进行核对。询问某个说法是否已核查，可获得结论（有支持、夸大、需要背景、相矛盾或未验证）、GRADE 确定性、单行说明及相关研究的 PubMed ID、证据等级和撤稿状态。通过 PubMed 和 OpenAlex 在 20 至 70 秒内实时核验新说法。还可查看演讲者履历、节目、主题、单项研究或公共资助登记中的资金来源。使用邮箱登录，预付额度按次付费（1 个额度 = 1 美分：读取 1、搜索说法 2、实时核验 30），每个回答显示费用和余额。内容是已发表研究的证据摘要，不是医疗建议。

payload.name: PartnerProf - Quanntum Core
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
PartnerProf is a unique tool that provides a deterministic answer to a fundamental question: does at least one feasible state exist within a locally defined reality governed by highly complex dependencies and constraints in a high-dimensional space?

Before committing resources to complex computation or a quantum problem, PartnerProf can determine whether a desired state, result, transition, or next step is feasible at all under the currently defined conditions.

Both the input and the resulting output can be certified, while the admitted state remains deterministic, reproducible, and fully auditable.

PartnerProf enables the evaluation of quantum and high-dimensional state-space problems that would otherwise be computationally impractical, including classes of simulations that may remain intractable even for current quantum hardware.

When facing a major and costly decision—or planning an experiment, test system, detector, prototype, or complex technical configuration—PartnerProf allows you to verify first whether the intended state is actually feasible within the defined reality before investing in its realization.
payload.longDescription:
PartnerProf 是一种独特工具，为一个基本问题提供确定性答案：在高维空间中，由高度复杂的依赖关系和约束支配的局部定义现实内，是否至少存在一个可行状态？

在为复杂计算或量子问题投入资源前，PartnerProf 可以确定：在当前定义的条件下，所需状态、结果、转换或下一步是否根本可行。

输入和由此产生的输出均可获得认证，而被判定为可行的状态保持确定性、可复现性和完全可审计性。

PartnerProf 支持评估量子及高维状态空间问题，否则这些问题在计算上可能难以实际处理，其中包括某些即使在当前量子硬件上也可能仍难以求解的模拟类型。

面临重大且成本高昂的决策，或规划实验、测试系统、探测器、原型或复杂技术配置时，PartnerProf 让你在投入资源实现目标前，先验证预期状态在所定义的现实内是否确实可行。

payload.name: QualiTaTi
payload.description: 开展 AI 访谈与问卷调查
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
QualiTaTi is an AI-powered qualitative research platform used by academic and UX researchers. This plugin connects ChatGPT and Codex to your QualiTaTi account through a hosted MCP server, so you can run a study end to end without leaving the conversation.

What you can do:
- Interview studies: create an AI-interview project from a topic, draft or refine the interview guide, set the language, voice or text mode and duration, and get the participant link to share. QualiTaTi's AI interviewer then runs the interviews with your participants and transcribes them. You can also import transcripts you already have.
- Progress and results: list your projects and interviews, see which interviews are complete and analysed, read each interview's conversation and quality score, and read the stored analyses (themes, codes, digests).
- Analysis: run the complete analysis or inductive coding on a finished interview (this spends QualiTaTi credits and is always confirmed with you first), then pull the results into the chat as evidence-backed summaries with verbatim quotes.
- Conversational surveys: build a survey from a brief, add questions and publish it; responses are then reviewed on qualitati.com.

Three bundled skills teach the model QualiTaTi's workflows: setting up an interview study, building a survey, and reading results. The plugin works with a free QualiTaTi account. Sign-in uses OAuth 2.1; the grant inherits your plan and quotas, and access tokens expire automatically.
payload.longDescription:
QualiTaTi 是供学术和 UX 研究人员使用的 AI 定性研究平台。此插件通过托管的 MCP 服务器将 ChatGPT 和 Codex 连接到你的 QualiTaTi 账户，让你无需离开对话即可完成端到端研究。

你可以：
- 访谈研究：围绕某个主题创建 AI 访谈项目、起草或完善访谈指南、设置语言、语音或文字模式及访谈时长，并获取可分享给参与者的链接。之后，QualiTaTi 的 AI 访谈员会与参与者进行访谈并转录内容。你也可以导入已有的文字记录。
- 进度与结果：列出项目和访谈，查看哪些访谈已完成并分析，阅读每次访谈的对话和质量评分，以及已保存的分析结果（主题、编码、摘要）。
- 分析：对已完成的访谈运行完整分析或归纳编码（这会消耗 QualiTaTi 额度，并且每次都会先征得你的确认），然后将结果提取到聊天中，生成有证据支持且包含原文引述的摘要。
- 对话式问卷：根据简报构建问卷、添加问题并发布；随后可在 qualitati.com 上查看回复。

随附的三项技能可教会模型 QualiTaTi 的工作流：开展访谈研究、构建问卷和阅读结果。此插件可配合免费的 QualiTaTi 账户使用。登录采用 OAuth 2.1；授权会继承你的方案和配额，访问令牌会自动过期。

payload.name: SciGrant
payload.description: 根据招募指南和表格逐项撰写研究经费申请
payload.summaryOriginal: 公募要領と様式から研究費申請書を項目ごとに作成
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
公募要領と申請書テンプレートに沿って、研究費申請の構想を整理し、申請書ドラフトを項目ごとに作成する会員向けの支援です。制度条件、審査観点、字数・様式制限を確認し、申請項目の整理、研究構想の具体化、項目ごとの執筆、予算・体制の整理、全体レビュー、提出前確認へ段階的に進みます。公募資料にない締切・予算上限・応募資格や、未実施の研究成果を推測で埋めません。

プラグインを選択して公募要領と申請書テンプレートを添付するだけでも開始できます。片方しかない場合は不足する資料だけを確認し、項目や工程ごとに利用者の確認を待ちながら進めます。生成された文章、引用文献、数値と公募条件は利用者による確認が必要です。採択を保証するサービスではありません。

完全版の執筆支援には、SciGrantの有効な利用権を登録した会員アカウントへの接続が必要です。既存の購入者は、提供済みの有料note内の登録リンクで製品の利用権を登録し、ChatGPT／Codexでプラグインを追加した後、登録時と同じログイン方法・同じ会員アカウントで接続してください。会員アカウントはnoteやChatGPTの登録アカウントと異なっていても利用できます。ログインだけでは利用権は付与されず、SciDraftの利用権とは別です。

会員サーバーは認証、製品別の利用権確認、保存済み執筆手順の配信を行い、その手順を受けたChatGPT／Codexが作成を支援します。研究資料・原稿・会話本文をMCPツールの入力として受け取りません。資料はChatGPT／Codexの会話に添付してください。申請システムへのログイン、実提出、決済は行いません。

利用期限は年度版ごとに定められ、購入日から1年間とは限りません。期限終了・利用停止後は完全版手順を新しく取得できません。既に取得した内容や過去のチャットを削除するものではありません。
payload.longDescription:
这是面向会员的支持服务，可根据招募指南和申请模板梳理研究经费申请构想，并逐项起草申请书。服务会核对制度条件、评审要点、字数和格式限制，并按步骤推进：整理申请项目、具体化研究构想、逐项撰写、梳理预算与团队配置、整体审阅以及提交前检查。不会臆测招募资料中未列明的截止日期、预算上限、申请资格，也不会编造尚未取得的研究成果。

只需选择此插件并附上招募指南和申请模板即可开始。如果缺少其中一份，只会询问缺少的资料，并在各项目或阶段等待用户确认后继续。生成的文本、引用文献、数字和招募条件都需要用户核实。本服务不保证获批。

要获得完整写作支持，必须连接已登记 SciGrant 有效使用权限的会员账户。现有购买者请通过已提供的付费 note 中的登记链接注册产品使用权，在 ChatGPT／Codex 中添加插件后，使用登记时相同的登录方式和同一会员账户连接。会员账户可以不同于 note 或 ChatGPT 的注册账户。仅登录不会获得使用权；其使用权也不同于 SciDraft 使用权。

会员服务器负责身份验证、核实对应产品的使用权限，以及分发已保存的写作流程；接收到流程的 ChatGPT／Codex 会协助创作。服务器不会将研究资料、稿件或对话正文作为 MCP 工具输入接收。请将资料附加到 ChatGPT／Codex 对话中。它不会登录申请系统、实际提交申请或处理付款。

使用期限按年度版本规定，并不一定从购买日起算 1 年。期限结束或使用权限停止后，无法再获取完整版本流程；但不会删除已获取的内容或过去的聊天记录。

payload.name: Tabulous
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Connect your AI assistant to a Tabulous workspace. It can look up Registry tables and records, list files on a record, and inspect toolkit scripts and apps, so you can ask questions about samples, experiments, and other lab data without leaving the chat.

When something needs to change, the assistant stages a complete plan as a changeset and gives you a review link. Invalid plans are rejected up front. Nothing is written to live data until you approve it.
payload.longDescription:
将 AI 助手连接到 Tabulous 工作区。它可以查询 Registry 表和记录、列出记录中的文件，并检查工具包脚本和应用，让你无需离开聊天就能询问样本、实验和其他实验室数据。

需要更改内容时，助手会将完整计划整理成变更集，并提供审核链接。无效计划会预先拒绝。在你批准之前，不会将任何内容写入线上数据。

payload.name: Selenium
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect your B12 account to research chemical synthesis strategies, assess routes, and develop a selected strategy into a detailed route. Compare literature evidence, starting materials, reaction steps, and uncertainties. Revisit saved assessments and planning results across conversations. Research and route-development availability depends on your account configuration. Proposed routes require expert review and experimental validation.
payload.longDescription: 连接您的B12账户以研究化学合成策略，评估路线，并将选定策略转化为详细路线。比较文献证据、起始材料、反应步骤和不确定性。在对话中回顾已保存的评估和规划结果。研究及路线开发功能的可用性取决于您的账户配置。建议的路线需要经过专家评审和实验验证。

payload.name: Biohub ESM
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Biohub ESM helps you understand proteins from a name, sequence, or file: explore mutation landscapes, interpret what ESMC sees, predict and view all-atom structures, and discover related proteins. It chooses the right ESM workflow, preserves confidence and provenance, and presents results automatically. It also supports MSA-guided and modified-complex workflows, and private or large-scale compute routing. Supported protein sequences use the Biohub MCP viewer. Complexes and exact prediction files use a separate molecular viewer when available, with an agent-generated static rendering as a last resort where local rendering tools are available. Managed inference requires a Biohub API key and may incur usage charges. Predictions support research hypotheses, not experimental conclusions.
payload.longDescription: Biohub ESM可通过蛋白质名称、序列或文件帮助您深入理解：探索突变图谱，解析ESMC看到的内容，预测并查看全原子结构，发现相关蛋白质。它会自动选择合适的ESM工作流，保留置信度和来源信息，并呈现结果。该工具支持多序列比对引导和修改后的复杂工作流，以及私有化或大规模计算资源调度。受支持的蛋白质序列使用Biohub MCP查看器，复合物和精确预测文件在可用时会使用独立分子查看器，当地渲染工具可用时则以代理生成的静态渲染作为最后手段。管理推理需要Biohub API密钥，可能产生使用费用。预测结果支持研究假设，而非实验结论。

payload.name: Prognyx oncology intelligence
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Live ClinicalTrials.gov oncology trial comparison around an asset, plus landscapes and CI briefings.

Free, read-only MCP server from Prognyx (oncology competitive intelligence). Three tools: compare_trials returns up to three interventional ClinicalTrials.gov studies around an asset or target in one oncology indication, side by side (sponsor, phase, status, declared arms, primary outcomes, last update, registry URL); search_registry gives the live landscape of a target, company, indication or NCT number (study counts, leading sponsors, phase mix, recent studies, related briefings); search_briefings searches Prognyx briefings, where each claim links to a primary source. No account, no API key. Registry records describe declared designs; a match does not establish that two programmes compete.
payload.longDescription:
围绕特定资产的实时临床试验.gov肿瘤学试验对比，以及全景图和CI简报。

Prognyx提供的免费只读MCP服务器（肿瘤学竞争情报）。
三个工具：compare_trials可在一种肿瘤学适应症中，围绕特定资产或靶点同时比较最多三项干预性临床试验.gov研究（赞助方、阶段、状态、声明的分组、主要结果、最后更新、注册URL）；search_registry可获取靶点、公司、适应症或NCT编号的实时全景图（研究数量、领先赞助方、阶段分布、近期研究、相关简报）；search_briefings可搜索Prognyx简报，每个声明均链接至原始来源。
无需账户，无需API密钥。
注册记录描述声明的设计；匹配并不表示两个项目存在竞争关系。
